records.english: On Wednesday evening, we went to the Town Hall.
records.chinese: 星期三晚上，我们去了市政厅
records.context: On Wednesday evening, we went to the Town Hall. It was the last day of the year and a large crowd of people had gathered under the Town Hall clock.

records.english: It was the last day of the year and a large crowd of people had gathered under the Town Hall clock.
records.chinese: 这是今年的最后一天，大批民众聚集在市政厅的钟下。
records.context: On Wednesday evening, we went to the Town Hall. It was the last day of the year and a large crowd of people had gathered under the Town Hall clock. It would strike twelve in twenty minutes' time.

records.english: It would strike twelve in twenty minutes' time.
records.chinese: 20分钟内会打12下
records.context: It was the last day of the year and a large crowd of people had gathered under the Town Hall clock. It would strike twelve in twenty minutes' time. Fifteen minutes passed and then, at five to twelve, the clock stopped.

records.english: Fifteen minutes passed and then, at five to twelve, the clock stopped.
records.chinese: 15分钟过去了，然后在5到12时钟停了下来。
records.context: It would strike twelve in twenty minutes' time. Fifteen minutes passed and then, at five to twelve, the clock stopped. The big minute hand did not move.

records.english: The big minute hand did not move.
records.chinese: 大一分钟的手没有动。
records.context: Fifteen minutes passed and then, at five to twelve, the clock stopped. The big minute hand did not move. We waited and waited, but nothing happened.

records.english: We waited and waited, but nothing happened.
records.chinese: 我们等待着等待着但什么都没发生
records.context: The big minute hand did not move. We waited and waited, but nothing happened. Suddenly someone shouted, ‘It's two minutes past twelve!

records.english: Suddenly someone shouted, ‘It's two minutes past twelve!
records.chinese: 突然有人大喊，“现在是12点两分钟！
records.context: We waited and waited, but nothing happened. Suddenly someone shouted, ‘It's two minutes past twelve! The clock has stopped!’

records.english: The clock has stopped!’
records.chinese: 钟停了！
records.context: Suddenly someone shouted, ‘It's two minutes past twelve! The clock has stopped!’ I looked at my watch.

records.english: I looked at my watch.
records.chinese: 我看着我的表
records.context: The clock has stopped!’ I looked at my watch. It was true.

records.english: It was true.
records.chinese: 这是真的。
records.context: I looked at my watch. It was true. The big clock refused to welcome the New Year.

records.english: The big clock refused to welcome the New Year.
records.chinese: 大钟拒绝欢迎新年
records.context: It was true. The big clock refused to welcome the New Year. At that moment, everybody began to laugh and sing.

records.english: At that moment, everybody began to laugh and sing.
records.chinese: 在那一刻，每个人都开始笑和唱歌。
records.context: The big clock refused to welcome the New Year. At that moment, everybody began to laugh and sing.

records.chinese: 她敲的钥匙太硬了，两根绳子断了
